title: Low-dose aspirin after 12 weeks of gestation for pregnant persons at high risk for preeclampsia

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends the use of low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) as preventive medication after 12 weeks of gestation in persons who are at high risk for preeclampsia.

action: Recommend low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) as preventive medication after 12 weeks of gestation in pregnant persons at high risk for preeclampsia.

uncomputable.needs: clinical determination that the pregnant person is at high risk for preeclampsia (risk factors defined in Practice Considerations, not in this section)

all.quote: persons who are at high risk for preeclampsia

uncomputable.needs: current gestational age greater than 12 weeks

denominator.quote: pregnant persons at high risk for preeclampsia

uncomputable.needs: record of low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) use as preventive medication; the criterion grammar has no medication type
